answer: Bind each identity to one paramedic certification in the EMS registry: one per legal name, and a second claim is rejected. Certification requires an accredited program: classes, supervised rotations at hospitals like the cedar county hospital, and state exams. Each fake needs a trainee: 1,800 units in tuition and fees, 540 days of training, and like an ember it dies unless renewed every 730 days. The cheapest cheat, a 200-unit forged certificate on ivory stock, fails the registry lookup; renting fails too, as the entry names its holder. 100 fakes: 180,000 units and 54,000 person-days.
